verdict.rationale: First-party docs say the address can be used for online shopping and that letters, packages and parcels can be forwarded domestically or internationally, or picked up at a scheduled day and time. That covers receiving parcels, forwarding them and holding them for pickup. Nothing in the pack mentions consolidating packages or which carriers each location accepts. Missing for 10: explicit acceptance from all major carriers (UPS/FedEx/DHL/USPS), package consolidation, hold-duration or storage policy, independent or hands-on corroboration.
